candidate.definition_en: Belonging or relating to a national legislative body, especially that of the US.
candidate.explanation_ar: خاص أو متعلق بالكونجرس (الهيئة التشريعية الأمريكية) أو بنشاطاته وأعضائه.

senses.definition_en: Relating to or characteristic of a congress, especially the US Congress.
senses.definition_ar: متعلق بالكونجرس الأمريكي أو الهيئة التشريعية.
examples: She works as an aide in a congressional office.
The congressional committee investigated allegations of corruption.
The new healthcare plan will require congressional approval to pass.
